name: Spanish Tortilla with Tomato Bread
description: A slow-cooked potato and egg tortilla served with garlic-rubbed tomato bread.

instructions: Cook the onion slowly in olive oil and butter until soft but not browned.
Add the potatoes, cover the pan, and cook until the slices are tender.
Stir in part of the garlic and the beaten eggs, then cook the tortilla gently until nearly set.
Invert the tortilla with a plate and slide it back into the pan to finish cooking.
Toast the bread, rub it with the remaining garlic and tomato, and drizzle it with olive oil.
Scatter parsley over the tortilla and serve it warm or cold with the tomato bread.
